I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from Pree's own June 9 message in that channel. They wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. I couldn't find any shared account files for Marrow Agrisupply, so I could only give the store name, not a site code. I told Pree that too.
